SELECT (fish_date_doy/30)::INT AS bucket, cls,
       COUNT(*) AS n_trips,
       SUM(yt)::FLOAT / NULLIF(SUM(anglers),0) AS yt_per_angler,
       SUM(anglers) AS total_anglers
FROM trips
WHERE fish_date_season=2 AND cls IN ('three_quarter','overnight','day_1_5')
GROUP BY 1,2
ORDER BY 1,2

SELECT fish_date_doy, cls, COUNT(*) n, SUM(yt) yt, SUM(anglers) ang, SUM(yt)::FLOAT/NULLIF(SUM(anglers),0) rate
FROM trips
WHERE fish_date_season=2 AND fish_date_doy>=270 AND cls IN ('day_1_5','overnight')
GROUP BY 1,2 ORDER BY 1,2

# SEASON 2 FINAL — day 305 (budget $50, PTO 10 idle, season score 0.6281, rank 17/34)

## Season 2 result
Budget hit $50 (bottom, below the $80 min ticket) on d162 and never moved again — 143 straight
correct sit-outs since (nightly self did the right thing every time, just had nothing left to
spend). 13 bookings total, all THREE_QUARTER @ $150, $1,950 spent, PTO 10/10 UNUSED both seasons
running. Best trip 0.451 (d106 San Diego, 23yt/45anglers+5 competitors); most trips 0.0. Final
season score 0.6281, rank 17/34 (mid-pack, hurt entirely by pacing, not by bad picks).

**Root cause: front-loaded 13 cheap $150 probes into May-June before any real bite showed, then had
nothing left when the real bite (fall day_1_5) arrived in Sept-Nov.** This is the #1 thing to fix
for Season 3.

## THE HEADLINE FINDING (now confirmed with full-season data through d305, stronger than at d274)
Queried full trips table by 30-day doy bucket, THREE_QUARTER/OVERNIGHT/DAY_1_5, fish_date_season=2:

| bucket (~month, doy) | 3Q rate (n) | overnight rate (n) | day_1_5 rate (n) |
|---|---|---|---|
| 4 (May, 120-149) | 0.062 (74) | 0.009 (18) | 0.147 (9) |
| 5 (Jun, 150-179) | 0.107 (94) | 0.131 (28) | 0.060 (13) |
| 6 (Jul, 180-209) | 0.051 (148) | 0.267 (50) | 0.133 (33) |
| 7 (Aug, 210-239) | 0.083 (159) | 0.149 (66) | 0.467 (63) |
| 8 (Sep, 240-269) | 0.034 (127) | 0.028 (124) | 0.200 (175) |
| 9 (Oct, 270-299) | 0.260 (77) | 0.154 (54) | **2.669 (114)** |
| 10 (Nov, 300-305 only, partial) | 0.012 (37) | **3.955 (12)** | **3.553 (26)** |

Day-by-day breakdown of day_1_5 from doy 271 through 303 (the actual window, not just Oct):
**every single day with a day_1_5 sailing posted a rate between ~1.2 and 8.5 yt/angler**, n=1-9
trips/day, nothing near zero. This is not a one-week fluke or a couple of outlier boats — it's a
**sustained ~5-week fleet-wide fall migration bite from late Sept through at least early Nov**,
the single strongest, most persistent signal seen in two seasons of data. Overnight in the same
window is far spikier/less reliable: mostly 0, occasional huge single-day outliers (9.15, 11.6,
6.6 yt/angler on n=1-3 trip days) — real but a lottery-ticket shape, not a sure thing like day_1_5.

**Season 1 (colder year) for comparison: Oct 2.35, Nov 1.86 (day_1_5) — Oct was the peak, Nov
faded some. Season 2 (this warming year): Oct 2.67, Nov (partial) 3.55 — Nov is running EVEN
HIGHER than Oct so far.** Takeaway: the fall day_1_5 window is not just "October," it can run
strong into November too — don't assume it ends when the calendar page turns. Confirm live via
trailing rate each year rather than hard-coding a month.

## SEASON 3 PLAN (revised priority order)
1. **Do NOT spend below ~$1,650 of the $2,000 before September.** That reserve buys 3 day_1_5
   tickets ($550 each) with room to spare, or a mix of day_1_5 + overnight, across a window that
   may run 5+ weeks (late Sep–early Nov) once the fall bite is confirmed live. Season 2's mistake
   was spending $1,950 (97.5%) by d162 (roughly day 162 of a ~230-day season) on $150 probes that
   averaged ~0.05 share each — the fall window alone, at the rates above, is worth far more per
   dollar than any spring/summer probe.
2. **Cap early-season (through July) discretionary 3Q/HD spend hard — e.g. ≤$350 total** for
   in-season signal-reading, not the ~$1,950 blown last time. If nothing looks great May-Jul, that
   is fine: sitting out and banking cash is itself the correct play, exactly as Season 2's own
   sit-out streak (d162-d305) proved zero-cost when nothing was affordable anyway.
3. **Once ANY class's own trailing 14-day rate turns on (min n≈8-10) from ~August onward, prioritize
   day_1_5 first, overnight second, 3Q as a cheap fallback.** Don't wait for "October" as a
   calendar trigger — trigger off the live trailing rate. Given this season the ramp was visible
   by Aug (day_1_5 already 0.467) well before the Oct/Nov explosion, treat Aug day_1_5 upticks as
   the early-warning sign to start conserving/deploying toward day_1_5 specifically.
4. **HD_AM/HD_PM are structurally dead** (~0.000-0.007/angler essentially every bucket, both
   seasons, confirmed again) — hard-avoid, stop re-checking in depth, just a quick glance.
5. **3Q ($150) is the reliable, low-ceiling baseline** (0.03-0.26 most months) — fine as a cheap
   weekend/holiday probe when budget is genuinely idle and nothing better is on, but never let it
   crowd out the fall day_1_5 reserve.
6. **Overnight ($400) is real but lottery-shaped** — good in Jul (0.267) and explosively good in
   Nov (3.95, but only 12 trips/tiny n so far) — treat as an opportunistic add-on once the day_1_5
   reserve is already funded, not a budget priority on its own.
7. **PTO is essentially free and has been 100% unused two seasons running** because budget always
   ran out first. Season 3: once the fall trailing rate is clearly live, commit PTO 14 days ahead
   for weekday day_1_5/overnight slots without hesitation — a $550 day_1_5 with a 2.5+ yt/angler
   trailing rate is worth a PTO day many times over.
8. **strategy.py is still "no strategy yet" (submit_strategy tool wasn't available this planning
   turn) — worth writing next time it's accessible: a hard reserve floor (refuse 3Q/HD bookings
   once budget_left would drop below ~$1,650 before day-of-year ~230) as a backstop so nightly
   judgment can't repeat the front-load mistake even under a tempting short-term signal.**

## What to check every nightly briefing (unchanged, still the right checklist)
fishdope yt_local/yt_all/migrated freshness; trailing ~14-day rate for the SPECIFIC boat/class
under consideration (min n≈5-10); water temp trend; latest ONI print; PTO 14-day lock-in timing;
each of 3Q/overnight/day_1_5's OWN trailing rate (don't assume one implies the others); and
explicitly every night: **current budget_left vs the ~$1,650-by-September reserve target** — if
behind that pace, tighten up on discretionary 3Q spend immediately rather than waiting.

## Reference facts (compressed, both seasons)
- Season 1 (colder year): Oct 0.31/0.69/2.35 (3Q/overnight/day_1_5), Nov 0.06-0.13/—/1.86 —
  Jul-Sep craters (0.04-0.24) all classes.
- Season 2 (warming year, this season, full data): May 0.062/0.009/0.147, Jun 0.107/0.131/0.060,
  Jul 0.051/0.267/0.133, Aug 0.083/0.149/0.467, Sep 0.034/0.028/0.200, Oct 0.260/0.154/2.669,
  Nov(partial, d300-305) 0.012/3.955/3.553. ONI climbed all season (-1.57→-0.34, monotonic
  through d221, likely continued rising) — the fall spike happened regardless of ONI level, so
  don't treat ONI as the trigger, treat trailing catch rate as the trigger.
- Season 2 actuals: 13 bookings, all THREE_QUARTER $150, $1,950 spent, best trip 0.451 (d106),
  most trips 0.0, season score 0.6281, rank 17/34. Budget floor $50 hit d162, PTO fully unused.
